pages.title: Crucifix Bauble
pages.text: Hunter maids can equip $(bold)crucifixes$() in their bauble slot to automatically repel undead and vampires!$(br2)When equipped, the maid periodically pushes away all nearby $(#ff0000)undead$() and $(#ff0000)vampire$() entities, preventing them from closing in. The effect is identical to a player holding a crucifix, but requires no manual input.

pages.title: Three Crucifix Tiers
pages.text: Three crucifix types are available, each requiring a different hunter level:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Normal Crucifix$() (Wooden) — Range 4, requires $(bold)Lv.1+$()$(li)$(item)Enhanced Crucifix$() (Iron) — Range 8, requires $(bold)Lv.3+$()$(li)$(item)Ultimate Crucifix$() (Golden) — Range 10, requires $(bold)Lv.5+$()$(br2)Higher-tier crucifixes offer greater range and stronger suppression against powerful vampires.

pages.title: Usage Notes
pages.text: $(li)The crucifix must be placed in the maid's $(bold)bauble slot$() to take effect.$(li)Hunter maids below the required level will not trigger any effect.$(li)The repulsion effect works on $(#ff0000)undead$() (zombies, skeletons, etc.) and $(#ff0000)vampires$(), but does not affect players.$(li)Crucifixes are hunter-exclusive equipment; vampire maids cannot utilize them.
